Name: NPCBOT_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: NPC bot tables: two different rows that share the ID are drawn by weight to fill the bot slots.

Fields.Name: NPC Param ID
Fields.Description: NpcParam of the bot character when this row is drawn. -1: none.

Fields.Name: NPC Think ID
Fields.Description: NpcThinkParam (AI) of the bot character when this row is drawn. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Character Init Param ID
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam row (equipment, stats, hero) of the bot character when this row is drawn. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Draw Weight
Fields.Description: Weight in the draw among rows sharing this row ID: up to two different rows are drawn, each by weight among the rows not drawn yet. 0: never drawn. Retail: 100 (200 on one row).
